title: Estrangement Between Banda Singh And Tat Khalsa

blocks.text: The imperial side thickens around Lahore while the Tat Khalsa stays firm at Amritsar, and Banda realizes too late that the Guru’s will is no longer with his separate project.
He attempts renewed contact and wants support, but the Khalsa refuses to surrender its authority to his ambitions.
Lahore anchors the page because it is the political horizon of Banda’s ambition and the space in which that ambition begins to fail.
